name: VoxCeleb1
description: A large-scale audio-visual dataset of YouTube interview videos, with over 100,000 utterances from 1,251 celebrities, designed for speaker recognition research.
citation: Nagrani, A., Chung, J. S., & Zisserman, A. (2017). VoxCeleb: A large-scale speaker identification dataset. Proceedings of Interspeech 2017, 2616–2620. https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2017-950

license.identifier: Research-only terms; no standard SPDX identifier
license.notes: The VoxCeleb website makes the dataset available for research use and provides terms governing access and use; these are not a standard SPDX license. Review the current upstream terms before downloading, using, or redistributing the dataset.
